title: Pool protocol v1 message: completion (router -> coordinator)
description: A served job finished. Feeds the per-request records (D-I3) and, via idle_ms_hint, the skip-the-line / soft-pin logic (D-E2, D-E3). ok is always true here; failures are reported with the "error" message. Anti-memory: token counts and timings only, never prompt/response content (D-I1).

ok.description: Always true in a completion (failures use the "error" message).

conv_key.description: Continuity key (64 hex) of the served conversation, or null if unknown.

model_id.description: Local model id that actually served the job.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the KV cache, or null if not measurable.

idle_ms_hint.description: How long the member's KV for this conversation is likely to stay warm, in ms; drives the skip-line (D-E2). null if unknown.

t_queued_ms.description: Time from intake to dispatch start, in ms.

t_service_ms.description: Service time (first token to end), in ms.

stop_reason.description: The engine's stop reason, e.g. "eos", "length", "stop". null if not available.

served_by.description: router_id of the router that served the job.
